_BOSWORTH_NE_DIYOR.alinti_1: The history of Šervānšāhs was clearly closely bound up with that of another Arab military family, the Hāšemis of Bāb al-abwāb/Darband … with the Šervānšāhs AT TIMES ruling in the latter town (at times invited into Darband by rebellious elements there).
_BOSWORTH_NE_DIYOR.alinti_2: The energies of the Yazidi Shahs had to be directed eastwards towards the Caspian, and ON VARIOUS OCCASIONS they expanded as far as Darband.
_BOSWORTH_NE_DIYOR.alinti_3: Ebrāhim b. Moḥammad of Darband (780-821/1378-1418) [came to power in Šervān, founding a second line of Shahs]
